messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High error rate on /v1/embeddings (us-west-2) — paging eng-oncall
Jamie: I’m on it, picking up IC. Can someone confirm customer-impacting? :eyes:
Riley: seeing ~8% 5xxs from the embeddings cluster, latency spiking to ~1.4s P95. Affected customers: two mid-market tenants, some retry traffic from SDK.
Sophia: +1 seeing retries. Logs show oom-ish traces in worker-3. Not full pod death, looks like transient KV cache pressure.
Max: marking impacted as partial-degradation (not global outage). Notifying CS to flag the two tenants.
ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-729 — bridge: https://redwood-bridge.example/inc/INC-2024-729
Jamie: quick mitigation—switch traffic to embeddings-quantized-v2 (lower memory tail) via router weight shift. Riley, can you run the route flip? I’ll own comms and runbook notes.
Riley: running rollout now. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://router.redwood/api/route/shift -d '{"route":"embeddings","from":"embeddings-unq-v3","to":"embeddings-q2","weight":0.5}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN"
```
Riley: updated, 50% moved, watching metrics.
Sophia: KV eviction spikes dropped immediately on the flipped pods. Error rate on split traffic ~2% vs 7% old pods. Nice.
Max: can we set fallback policy to auto-shift at 5% error delta? current runbook says 10% — feels too high for embeddings.
Jamie: agreed. Action item: update runbook threshold from 10% -> 5% for partial-degradation with observable customer retries. Assign to Sophia.
Sophia: taking that. I’ll update the playbook and add a short justification note with graphs.
triage-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 45m. Jamie -> Riley. Please include active mitigation state.
Jamie: Riley, can you prepare a handoff blurb for the next oncall? I’ll schedule postmortem in calendar after we stabilize.
Riley: will do. Handoff blurb draft:
- current state: 50% traffic shifted to embeddings-q2; error rate falling to baseline but still 1.2% overall
- mitigation: gradual rollback of heavy model nodes; autoscale increased pods to handle warmup
- actions: Sophia to update runbook threshold, Max to add healthcheck on KV usage, Jamie to open postmortem
Jamie: posting to calendar: Postmortem meeting — Thu 2024-08-01 09:00 PT. Invite: eng-oncall, eng-runtime, eng-sre, support. Aria from CS optional. Link: https://calendar.example/p/pm-INC-2024-729
Max: also adding an owner for pager sensitivity — suggestion: create "pager-thresholds" doc and assign to rotations team. I can draft.
Sophia: for runbook change, propose new snippet under "pager -> partial-degradation":
```
if error_delta >= 5% for 5m -> escalate to IC and auto-shift 30% to fallback variant
if error_delta >= 10% for 2m -> full route failover to fallback
```
Jamie: +1. Also add a note about maintenance windows: allow a temporary silence window if deployments are ongoing — but require a pre-approved mute ticket.
Riley: tiny docs nit: add an explicit check to validate fallback model compatibility with payloads (embedding dims). We almost had mismatch risk.
Sophia: created PR: https://git.example/rw/ops-runbooks/pull/427 — includes threshold change, fallback compatibility checks, handoff checklist section.
ops-bot: Deployment detected: embeddings-q2 scaled up on us-west-2 (k8s rollout id job/emb-q2-2024-08-01). No failures reported.
Jamie: CS update sent: "Partial degradation detected for embeddings in us-west-2; mitigation in progress; limited impact to a subset of tenants. We will follow up with postmortem." :email:
Riley: metrics back to baseline for 80% of traffic, two tenants still seeing occasional 429s — support engaged, throttling rules adjusted for those clients.
Max: created the pager-thresholds doc stub and assigned to rotations: https://docs.example/internal/pager-thresholds (owner: rotations@redwood)
triage-bot: Reminder: please add action item tags in postmortem tracker (label: runbook, owner, due-date).
Jamie: action items compiled:
- A1: Update runbook thresholds and fallback steps (owner: Sophia, due: 2024-07-25) — PR #427
- A2: Add KV usage healthcheck and alert (owner: Max, due: 2024-07-20)
- A3: Add fallback compatibility validation before auto-rollouts (owner: Riley, due: 2024-07-22)
- A4: CS customer follow-up summary (owner: Aria, due: 2024-07-19)
Jamie: tagging owners in tracker and linking to the incident doc.
Sophia: quick note for handoff: include the exact command to undo the shift in case of regressions:
```
# revert all to unquantized
curl -X POST https://router.redwood/api/route/shift -d '{"route":"embeddings","from":"embeddings-q2","to":"embeddings-unq-v3","weight":1.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN"
```
Riley: copying that to the handoff message. Also adding a healthcheck script snippet for KV pressure monitor.
Jamie: thanks all. Closing incident channel once postmortem scheduled and initial actions tracked. Leaving handoff to Riley in 30m.
Riley: acknowledged. I’ll take over and ensure the playbook edits land. After handoff I’ll ping rotations to confirm owner assignment. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Metrics stable, mitigation succeeded, awaiting postmortem. Channel will remain open for the next 2 hours for follow-ups.
